text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Phew, training with someone else feels nice.
It reminds me of the old days.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's try a 'Tuning' as a test run.
There won't be an 'Upgrade Exam' this time.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, even if I say "tuning,"
there is no need to be frightened. Nothing will break,
so rest assured.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Now, feel free to tune this machine
however you see fit.
